culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. The IBAP code of conduct for the Bijagos says not to photograph sacred sites (balobas, sacred groves) unless your guide allows it, and to ask before photographing people. Give gifts through the lodge, not directly. Some sacred islands are open only to initiated elders.

laws.rule: Under Decree-Law 2-B/93, using, or growing, buying or holding a small quantity for personal use carries 1 to 6 months' prison for cannabis derivatives, 2 months to 1 year for high-risk drugs including cannabis oil, and 15 days to 3 months for lower-risk drugs (article 20). Trafficking high-risk drugs carries 2 to 12 years (article 3).
